ai.title: AI Model
ai.noModels: No models available. Please check API key configuration.
ai.modelHint: Model used for the main chat. The Anthropic and GPT dropdowns below are «either-or» — picking one clears the other. The two background tasks (URL extraction and search translation) can be configured separately in Advanced Options below; you don't need to keep them on the same provider as main chat.
ai.deepReasoningHint: When enabled, the model thinks longer before answering — useful for trend analysis or pricing suggestions. Off by default since everyday queries are faster and cheaper without it.
ai.advancedDescription: The two background tasks each have their own default behavior, described below. You can override either of them independently of the main chat model.
ai.backgroundModelHint: When importing an artwork from a URL, the AI reads the page and extracts title, year, materials, and so on. **Follows the main chat model by default** — change main chat and this follows. If your main chat is set to a model that struggles with structured extraction (e.g. a very small fast model), set a stronger one here.
ai.searchExpansionModelHint: When AI tools search the materials or type fields of artworks, this model first translates your Chinese input into English (those fields are stored in English in the database). **Independent of main chat** — defaults to a lightweight model and isn't affected by main chat changes. Pick something stronger here if you need more accurate translation.

export.title: Data Export
export.jsonDescription: Structured backup: artworks, editions, locations, files, history (files/history nested under editions)
export.mdDescription: Human-readable: artwork + editions + file links + history, mirroring the JSON structure
export.exportHint: Regular JSON or MD backups are recommended to prevent data loss
